purpose: Teach: 州立/施主/廻っ/下層/席上/呼応/デマンド/無休

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、州立大学との連携を進められた
lines.en: Father — when founding the company, he pioneered the partnership with the state university.
lines.style: Gentle, remembering. Slight upward lilt on the name — calling him back into the room. Pause before the detail, as if seeing it happen again. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは建築の施主との信頼を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father placed great trust in his relationships with the architects and their clients.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Quiet weight on 「信頼」 — the word that mattered most to him. Not lecturing, but honoring. Eyes distant and close at once.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、自ら工場を廻って見られた
lines.en: Father walked the factory floors himself to see what was happening there.
lines.style: Soft nostalgia in the voice. Slight breathiness on the opening — the weight of that memory. Pace slows on the visual: the factory, the floors. Small pause at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは下層工員の声を聞かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father listened to the voices of the workers on the line — even the ones at the bottom.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Emphasis lands on 「聞かれた」 — the act of listening as moral choice. Warm but serious. No sentimentality, just fact and respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、株主総会の席上で堂々と語られた
lines.en: Father stood up in the shareholder meetings and spoke plainly about what needed to be done.
lines.style: Admiration suffusing the words. Slight lift on 「堂々と」 — he was proud of that courage. Pace steady, not rushed. The voice of someone recalling bravery he witnessed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは時代に呼応した経営をされた
lines.en: Yes. Father built the company to move with the times, not against them.
lines.style: Measured and clear. Slight emphasis on 「呼応」 — responsiveness as wisdom. Not proud, but certain. The voice of someone who understands what that cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、デマンド予測を独自に立てられた
lines.en: Father made his own demand forecasts — didn't follow what others were doing.
lines.style: Contemplative wonder. Breath held slightly before 「独自に」 — the audacity of that independence. Slow pace. Trailing off slightly, as if still amazed at his foresight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業期、無休で働かれた
lines.en: Yes. In those early days, Father didn't take a single day off.
lines.style: Quiet, final statement. Weight settles on each word like a closing door. Slow, measured pace. The voice of someone who understands sacrifice fully, and honors it without drama.
